validation_step.description: Independent non-circular validation before irreversible actions. When has_irreversible_action is true, CLEAR requires independent=true AND a versioned log pointer (log_pointer + validation_log_version). Absence → Gate ISO fail. PROMETHEUS consumes; no fifth bot.

present.description: True when a validation step exists. Alias of validation_isolation.enabled

independent.description: Boolean attestation that validator is non-circular vs planner (SHADOW — no proof protocol). Alias of validation_isolation.independent_of_planner

log_pointer.description: Alias of packet validation_isolation.validation_log_pointer — versioned log / receipt path or URI

validation_log_version.description: Version or content-hash of the validation log at log_pointer (parity with wayfinder validation_isolation.validation_log_version)

has_irreversible_action.description: True when any action can irreversibly affect users/spend/egress
